Göktürks.name: Ashina Rangan
Göktürks.title: Yami Khagan
Göktürks.note: Put on the throne with Sui backing.

Yamato.name: Suiko
Yamato.title: Empress Suiko
Yamato.note: Prince Shōtoku acted as regent for much of her reign.

sides.name: Chen
sides.troops_text_zh: 建康守军十余万（史书记载）

sui-conquers-chen.note: Numbers are from the official histories.
sui-conquers-chen.note_zh: 兵力数字出自正史记载。

sides.name: Sui
sides.troops_text: 1,133,800 combat troops (official figure); 305,000 crossed the Yalu

goguryeo-campaign.note: The Sui totals are from the official histories and are probably inflated.
goguryeo-campaign.note_zh: 隋军人数出自正史，可能有所夸大。
goguryeo-campaign.losses: Only about 2,700 of the 305,000 returned (Sui records)
goguryeo-campaign.losses_zh: 渡江的30.5万人仅约2700人生还（据《隋书》）

yang-xuangan.note: Fan Zigai defended Luoyang until armies returning from Korea arrived.
yang-xuangan.note_zh: 樊子盖坚守洛阳，直到征辽大军回师。

sides.name: Eastern Turks
sides.troops_text: said to be several hundred thousand horsemen

siege-yanmen.note: The Turks lifted the siege as Sui relief armies gathered; the young Li Shimin served in one of them.
siege-yanmen.note_zh: 隋朝援军陆续赶到，突厥解围北返；少年李世民也在援军之中。

routes.name: Sui armies cross the Yangtze
routes.summary: Sui armies gathered on the Huai and crossed the Yangtze near Caishi and Jingkou to take Jiankang.
routes.summary_zh: 隋军集结于淮河一线，从采石、京口一带渡过长江，攻下建康。

routes.name: Yang Su's fleet down the Yangtze
routes.summary: Yang Su's warships sailed down through the Three Gorges and pinned Chen forces on the middle Yangtze.
routes.summary_zh: 杨素率战船出三峡顺流东下，牵制长江中游的陈军。

routes.name: Sui Grand Canal
routes.summary: Canals dug under Emperor Yang (605-610) linked Zhuojun near Beijing, Luoyang and Hangzhou by water.
routes.summary_zh: 隋炀帝时（605—610年）开凿的运河，用水路连通了涿郡（今北京附近）、洛阳和余杭（今杭州）。

routes.name: Emperor Yang's western tour
routes.summary: Emperor Yang crossed the Qilian Mountains to Zhangye and received envoys from the Western Regions.
routes.summary_zh: 隋炀帝翻越祁连山到达张掖，接见西域各国使节。

routes.name: Sui invasion of Goguryeo
routes.summary: The army marched from Zhuojun to the Liao River; a strike force crossed the Yalu toward Pyongyang and was destroyed at the Salsu River.
routes.summary_zh: 大军从涿郡出发到达辽河；一支精兵渡过鸭绿江直逼平壤，在萨水大败。

people.name: Yuwen Kai
people.known_for: Architect who planned the new Sui capital Daxing and the Eastern Capital at Luoyang.
people.known_for_zh: 隋代建筑家，主持规划建造了大兴城和东都洛阳。

people.name: Zhiyi
people.known_for: Monk who founded the Tiantai school, the first major Chinese school of Buddhism.
people.known_for_zh: 高僧，创立天台宗，这是第一个由中国人创立的佛教宗派。

people.name: Yan Zhitui
people.known_for: Scholar whose family advice book is the classic of Chinese family teaching.
people.known_for_zh: 学者，所著《颜氏家训》是家训类著作的经典。

works.title: The Family Instructions of Master Yan

people.name: Lu Fayan
people.known_for: Compiled the Qieyun (601), the rhyme dictionary behind later Chinese phonology.
people.known_for_zh: 编成韵书《切韵》（601年），是后世音韵学的基础。

people.name: Zhan Ziqian
people.known_for: Painter of 'Spring Outing', often called the oldest surviving Chinese landscape scroll.
people.known_for_zh: 画家，传世《游春图》常被视为现存最早的山水画卷。

people.name: Chao Yuanfang
people.known_for: Court physician who led the writing of a great treatise on the causes of diseases (610).
people.known_for_zh: 隋代太医，主持编撰《诸病源候论》（610年），系统论述疾病病因。

works.title: Treatise on the Causes and Symptoms of Diseases

people.name: Xue Daoheng
people.known_for: The leading poet of the Sui court.
people.known_for_zh: 隋代最负盛名的诗人。
people.line_zh: 暗牖悬蛛网，空梁落燕泥。
people.line_en: Spiders hang webs at the dark window; swallows drop mud from the empty beam.

people.name: Wang Tong
people.known_for: Confucian teacher whose school trained many early Tang statesmen.
people.known_for_zh: 儒家学者，讲学河汾，门下出了不少唐初名臣。

people.name: Yang Jian (Emperor Wen of Sui)
people.known_for: Founder of the Sui who reunified China in 589 and introduced the Three Departments and Six Ministries.
people.known_for_zh: 隋文帝，589年统一全国，创三省六部制。

people.name: Yang Guang (Emperor Yang of Sui)
people.known_for: Sui emperor who built the Grand Canal and Eastern Capital but exhausted the realm with Korean wars.
people.known_for_zh: 隋炀帝，开凿大运河、营建东都，征高句丽致亡国。

people.name: Empress Dugu Qieluo
people.known_for: Influential empress of Emperor Wen, co-ruler in all but name, known as one of the 'Two Sages'.
people.known_for_zh: 隋文帝独孤皇后，参与朝政，与文帝并称“二圣”。

people.name: Gao Jiong
people.known_for: Chief minister who organised the conquest of Chen and the building of Daxing city.
people.known_for_zh: 隋朝名相，主持灭陈之役与营建大兴城。

people.name: Yang Su
people.known_for: Leading Sui general and minister who commanded the fleet against Chen and built the Renshou Palace.
people.known_for_zh: 隋朝名将权臣，领水军灭陈，督建仁寿宫。

people.name: Han Qinhu
people.known_for: Sui general who captured Jiankang and the last Chen emperor in 589.
people.known_for_zh: 隋朝名将，589年率先攻入建康，俘陈后主。

people.name: Heruo Bi
people.known_for: Sui general who crossed the Yangtze to defeat the Chen army in the 589 conquest.
people.known_for_zh: 隋朝名将，渡江大败陈军，平陈功臣。

people.name: Li Chun
people.known_for: Engineer who built the Anji (Zhaozhou) Bridge, the world's oldest open-spandrel stone arch bridge.
people.known_for_zh: 工匠，设计建造赵州桥，世界最古老的敞肩石拱桥。

people.name: Pei Ju
people.known_for: Sui official who managed Silk Road trade at Zhangye and wrote the Illustrated Records of the Western Regions.
people.known_for_zh: 隋臣，主持张掖互市，著《西域图记》。

works.title: Illustrated Records of the Western Regions

people.name: Zhiyong
people.known_for: Monk-calligrapher and descendant of Wang Xizhi whose Thousand Character Classic set models for later scripts.
people.known_for_zh: 王羲之七世孙，书法僧，书《真草千字文》。

works.title: Thousand Character Classic in Two Scripts

people.name: Jizang
people.known_for: Monk and systematiser of the Three Treatise (Sanlun) school of Madhyamaka Buddhism.
people.known_for_zh: 三论宗集大成者。

people.name: Liu Zhuo
people.known_for: Astronomer whose Huangji calendar first used quadratic interpolation for solar motion.
people.known_for_zh: 天文学家，制《皇极历》，首创二次内插法。

people.name: Li Mi
people.known_for: Leader of the Wagang rebel army, the most powerful insurgent force against the late Sui.
people.known_for_zh: 隋末瓦岗军首领。

people.name: Dou Jiande
people.known_for: Hebei rebel leader who founded the Xia state and was defeated by Li Shimin at Hulao.
people.known_for_zh: 隋末河北义军领袖，建夏国，虎牢之战败于李世民。

people.name: Wang Shichong
people.known_for: Sui general who seized Luoyang and declared the Zheng dynasty before surrendering to Tang.
people.known_for_zh: 隋末据洛阳称帝建郑，后降唐。

people.name: Lady Xian
people.known_for: Li chieftain who kept Lingnan peaceful and loyal through the Liang, Chen and Sui dynasties.
people.known_for_zh: 岭南俚族首领，历梁陈隋三朝保境安民。

people.name: Sun Simiao
people.known_for: Revered physician, honoured as the 'King of Medicine'.
people.known_for_zh: 著名医学家，被尊为“药王”。

works.title: Essential Formulas Worth a Thousand Gold

people.name: Wei Zheng
people.known_for: Chancellor famed for blunt remonstrance; Taizong called him the mirror for seeing his faults.
people.known_for_zh: 以直谏著称的名相，太宗称其为“镜”。

people.name: Fang Xuanling
people.known_for: Long-serving chancellor of Taizong who led compilation of the Book of Jin.
people.known_for_zh: 贞观名相，“房谋杜断”之房，主修《晋书》。

people.name: Li Jing
people.known_for: Tang general who destroyed the Eastern Turkic Khaganate in 630.
people.known_for_zh: 唐初名将，630年大破东突厥。

people.name: Ouyang Xun
people.known_for: Calligrapher whose precise regular script (Ou style) is a classic model.
people.known_for_zh: 书法家，楷书“欧体”创始人。

capitals.name: Daxing (Chang'an)
capitals.note: The new Daxing city was built in 582–583 beside the old Han Chang'an.
capitals.note_zh: 582—583年在汉长安城东南另建新城大兴城。

capitals.name: Luoyang (Eastern Capital)
capitals.note: Emperor Yang built the Eastern Capital in 605 and often ruled from it.
capitals.note_zh: 隋炀帝605年营建东都，常驻于此。

capitals.name: Jiangdu
capitals.note: Emperor Yang moved his court here in 616 and was killed here in 618.
capitals.note_zh: 隋炀帝616年南下江都，618年在此被杀。
